title: One in four Ellsworth missile security police saw something
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: one out of every four has probably seen something in the night sky

plain: Mario Woods, a former guard of nuclear missiles at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, spoke on a podcast about his time there. He says that among the security police guarding the missiles, about one in every four has probably seen something strange in the night sky. If true, it would mean such sightings were common among the people protecting the weapons.
